Shift+клик по вершине или Shift+рамка —: Shift+click a vertex or Shift+drag a box to select several base vertices: grabbing any moves them all, Del deletes them all.

Рассечь: кликните по ребру верхней грани: Split: click an edge of the top face to start a cut, or inside the face to draw a closed ring (courtyard, tower). Esc to exit.
Кольцо: кликайте внутри грани, клик в пе: Ring: click inside the face; clicking the first point closes it. Shift holds the axis. Backspace removes a point, Esc cancels.
Точки кольца — внутри верхней грани, не: Ring points must be inside the top face, not on its edges.
Кликните в первую точку, чтобы замкнуть: Click the first point to close the ring, or keep going. Backspace removes a point.
A ring needs at least three points.
Кольцо касается контура или пересекает е: The ring touches or crosses the outline — it must lie inside the face.
The ring must lie inside the face.
Внутри кольца уже есть внутреннее кольцо: There is already an inner ring inside this ring — this cut isn't supported yet.
Вырезано кольцо: у {key} дыра, внутри —: Ring cut: {key} now has a hole with a new part {part} inside. Delete it (Del) for a courtyard, or pull it (P) for a tower or atrium.
Кольцо в отдельном здании-мультиполигоне: Rings can't be cut into a standalone multipolygon building yet: split it into parts first.
Выделите две или больше частей (Shift+кл: Select two or more parts (Shift+click), then Merge.
Объединять можно только части, контур зд: Only parts can be merged, not the building outline.
Для объединения нужны пути-члены мультип: Merging needs the multipolygon's member ways — reload the visible tiles.
Объединять можно части с одинаковыми тег: Only parts with the same volume tags can be merged; these differ: {tags}.
Части не соприкасаются: объединить можно: The parts don't touch: only parts that share a side can be merged.
M — переместить, Q — повернуть, A — выро: M — move, Q — rotate, A — square corners (90°), P — push, K — split, J — merge, R / L / C / N — new part (rectangle, polygon, circle, regular polygon), O — offset, T — tape measure, B — paint.
Делит верхнюю грань части на две части с: Splits a part's top face into two parts with the same tags, or cuts a ring into it — a hole with a new part inside.
Клик по ребру верхней грани — начало раз: Click an edge of the top face to start the cut, click inside the face to add bends, click another edge of the same face to finish.
Первый клик внутри грани (не у ребра) —: A first click inside the face (away from the edges) starts a closed ring; clicking the first point closes it. Delete the inner part (Del) for a courtyard, or push it (P) for a tower or atrium.
Backspace — убрать последнюю точку кольц: Backspace removes the last ring point, Shift holds the axis. Esc cancels.
Объединить выделенные части с одинаковым: Merge the selected parts with the same volume tags (J)
Разрез от внутреннего кольца до внешнего: A cut from an inner ring to the outer one (or to another inner ring) does not divide the face — start and finish it on the same ring.
Резать у внутреннего кольца отдельного з: Cutting at an inner ring of a standalone building is not supported yet: split it into parts first.
The cut runs outside the face.
Разрез касается внутреннего кольца не ко: The cut touches the inner ring somewhere other than its ends.
Разрез идёт по стороне кольца — отрезать: The cut runs along a side of the ring; nothing to cut off.
Внутри отрезаемого куска есть другое вну: The piece being cut off contains another inner ring — this cut is not supported yet.
Изолирована часть {key}. Двойной клик по: Isolated part {key}. Double-click empty space to show all parts, Ctrl+Z to undo.
Показаны все части. Двойной клик по пуст: All parts shown. Double-click empty space again to exit building mode.
Двойной клик по части — изолировать её (: Double-click a part to isolate it (the rest are hidden); double-click outside the building to show all parts, or, if none are hidden, to go back to the map.
Esc — снять выделение, ещё раз — назад к: Esc clears the selection; press it again to go back to the map.
Клик по части — выделить её, Shift — нес: Click a part to select it, Shift for several. Double-click a part to isolate it; double-click outside the building to show all parts or exit.
Пробел — выключить инструмент. G — сетка: Space: turn the tool off. G: grid, S: snapping, H: hide a part, I: isolate selected, Shift+H: show all.
Выделите части (Shift+клик — несколько),: Select parts (Shift+click for several), then press I to isolate them.
Изолировано частей: {n}. Двойной клик по: Isolated parts: {n}. Double-click empty space or press Shift+H to show all, Ctrl+Z to undo.
Стена заходит в соседний двор или пересе: The wall would run into the neighbouring courtyard or cross other walls of the part — this push is not possible.
Контур здания с building:part — ещё и ча: A building outline with building:part is also a part and is drawn as a volume. Empty — outline only, no volume.
Контур здания (outline) на части не дели: The building outline can't be split into parts — only an inner ring can be cut: click inside the face or bring the cut back to its starting point.
Вырезано кольцо: у контура здания {key}: Ring cut: the building outline {key} now has a courtyard.
Сомкнуть вырез во двор у отдельного здан: Closing a notch into a courtyard isn't supported for a standalone building yet — build the building relation first.
